description: Use when you want a book's realized residual return over a date window attributed to stock selection versus drift. Not for current risk or hedges (use riskmodels_portfolio_exposure). Returns, from POST /cohorts/pnl-decomposition, selection (from holding names that beat their cohort's average residual) and drift (from net exposure to the cohort average), which sum exactly to the total; weights are held constant over the window and not normalized, a short is a negative weight, and positions that cannot be mapped to a cohort are listed in coverage.dropped. Historical attribution on end-of-day data. Price: $0.25 per call.

include_series.description: true adds the daily selection and drift series (large), e.g. true (default false)

min_names.description: Ignore cohort means on days the cohort had fewer members, integer, e.g. 20

positions.description: The book to attribute, 1-500 positions, e.g. [{"ticker":"MSFT","weight":0.1},{"ticker":"INTC","weight":-0.05}]

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. MSFT

weight.description: Portfolio weight as a decimal, negative for a short, e.g. -0.05

name: riskmodels_decompose_selection_vs_drift
title: RiskModels Selection vs Drift
